title: Great option for a hike uphill at your own pace
text: Jeremy was a great guide that went out of his way to lead us on a nice pace and climb in a non strenuous way up.  He gave us a lot of insight as a local about this lovely city.  He has had many life experiences for a young man and we had an interesting morning
author: Lucy_S

title: Our guide Jeremy, took us...
text: Our guide Jeremy, took us on an walking tour through the Albaycin and Sacromonte areas of the city.  We loved it!  He is an extraordinary guide and Granda is enchanting.
author: Ana_A
